title: Facing Direction
description: This is a fabric mod that helps you visualize what direction you are going.
body:
# 🧭 Compass HUD

A lightweight, always-on compass overlay for Fabric — know exactly where you're headed at a glance.

![Navigation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e39b5b72d4af841f0b0e922d5c83314b2529bbb.png)

## About

Compass HUD adds a clean, minimal direction bar to your screen that displays all eight cardinal and intercardinal directions **(SW, W, NW, N, NE, E, SE)** and highlights the one you are currently facing in real time. No more getting lost, no more opening your inventory to check coordinates. Just look up and go.


## ✨ Features

- 🧭 **Always-visible compass** — Shows all 8 directions with your current facing highlighted in real time
- ⚡ **Highly optimized** — Extremely lightweight with zero noticeable impact on FPS or performance
- 🔧 **Mod Menu support** — Fully compatible with Mod Menu so you can manage it alongside your other mods
- 📦 **Client-side only** — Works on any server, no server-side installation required


## 📋 Requirements

- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(optional but recommended)*
